title: Design System: Bay Area Golf Register

motion.name: arrow-hover
motion.purpose: Directional response on booking links; removed for reduced motion.

components.name: Activity Tab
components.description: A plain activity filter with a coral active underline.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" aria-label="Activity"><button class="ds-tab ds-active" aria-pressed="true">All places</button><button class="ds-tab" aria-pressed="false">Play holes</button><button class="ds-tab" aria-pressed="false">Driving range</button></nav>

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A compact labelled search field for narrowing the register.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;color:var(--muted);font:750 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:39px;border:1px solid #aebfb0;border-radius:5px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);padding:8px 11px;font:400 16px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:#68796d}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--ink)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Area Select
components.description: A compact dropdown with the same field geometry as search.
components.css: .ds-select{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;color:var(--muted);font:750 12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-select select{min-height:39px;border:1px solid #aebfb0;border-radius:5px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);padding:8px 11px;font:400 16px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-select select:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}.ds-select select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(210px,2.2fr) minmax(115px,1fr) minmax(115px,1fr) minmax(130px,1fr);gap:18px;align-items:start;padding:19px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--white);color:var(--body);transition:background .2s ease}.ds-row:hover{background:#f0f5e9}.ds-place h3{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font:400 1.36rem/1.15 Georgia,"Iowan Old Style",serif;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-place p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font:400 .79rem/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-fact{display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:var(--muted);font:650 .77rem/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-fact strong{color:var(--ink);font-size:1.27rem;line-height:1.15;font-weight:730;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-go{display:block;border-radius:4px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:9px 11px;text-decoration:none;font:750 .8rem -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}.ds-go:hover{background:#2b5b41}.ds-go:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px 12px}.ds-place{grid-column:span 2}.ds-go{grid-column:span 2;max-width:200px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-row{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
The register feels like a practical field guide carried to the course. Cool field paper, deep evergreen ink, fine rules, and restrained coral marks make the information feel collected and trustworthy. A large serif title adds character while compact sans serif controls and figures keep comparisons quick.

The page is intentionally dense enough to show the start of the register in the first desktop viewport. Repeated rows carry the visual rhythm; the illustration and color accents stay secondary to names, fees, and direct actions.
keyCharacteristics: Cool field paper and flat white surfaces with evergreen type.
Ruled, tabular rows instead of promotional tiles.
Serif editorial headings with small, clear sans serif labels.
Coral reserved for selected or saved states.

rules.name: The Marker Rule
rules.body: Keep coral for selected states and brief accents so prices and booking actions remain easy to scan.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use serif for named places and major headings; use sans serif for controls, prices, and operational detail.

rules.name: The First Row Rule
rules.body: Keep the masthead and filters compact enough that the register starts within the first desktop viewport.

rules.name: The Ruled Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate repeated information with fine lines and tonal changes, not floating cards.

dos: Do keep facts in aligned, ruled rows with the place column wider than price columns.
Do show a visible focus outline and preserve text labels on controls.
Do use coral sparingly for active tabs and saved state.
donts: Don't add drop shadows or raised promotional cards to the register.
Don't replace tabular fee figures with decorative price badges.
Don't let the masthead push the register below the first desktop viewport.
